mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id, user_id, CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 2 ELSE status END AS status, contract_version, form_version, form_data, submitted_at, updated_at, COALESCE(cancelled_at, invalidated_at) AS cancelled_at, invalidated_at, invalidated_by, invalid_reason, created_at FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND (status = #{status} OR (#{status} = 2 AND status = 3)) ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND (status = #{status} OR (#{status} = 2 AND status = 3))

SELECT id, activity_id, user_id, CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 2 ELSE status END AS status, contract_version, form_version, form_data, submitted_at, updated_at, COALESCE(cancelled_at, invalidated_at) AS cancelled_at, invalidated_at, invalidated_by, invalid_reason, created_at FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND (status = #{status} OR (#{status} = 2 AND status = 3)) ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_registration SET status = 1, form_data = #{data}, submitted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, cancelled_at = NULL, contract_version = contract_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND invalidated_at IS NULL
UPDATE activity_registration SET status = 2, cancelled_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, contract_version = contract_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

UPDATE activity_registration SET status = 1, form_data = #{data}, form_version = #{formVersion}, submitted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, cancelled_at = NULL, contract_version = contract_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND contract_version = #{version}
